product: VMware Cloud Foundation 9.0 - vSphere Automation API for vCenter
note: Every row below is a pointer into one OpenAPI document at one immutable commit. No documentation page was used, and the 9.1.0.0 revision of the same file was not consulted.

excluded_revision.reason: same spec_path at the later tag; deliberately not used as the source of this contract

operations.used_for: exchange the vCenter credentials for the vmware-api-session-id used by every later call
pre-flight read of the power state before any hardware change is submitted
step 1 of the change: resize memory and optionally toggle hot-add
step 2 of the change: attach a newly created VMDK backing
step 3 of the change: attach a virtual Ethernet adapter to a portgroup
step 4 of the change: the power-on that may fail after the earlier steps have already landed
release the session on every exit path, including the failing one
